name: Saryth
description: A woman with glowing green eyes whose power is in the mask; she feeds ensorcelled villagers to eggs to call the Coiled One and is swallowed by the chasm.

timeline.summary: Leinore sees Sinnia drag an unconscious man to a giant egg that opens and swallows him, and notices a woman watching from the shadows.
timeline.quote: To Leinore's horror, she watched her sister push the unconscious man into it.

timeline.summary: Katilda reveals that the woman is Saryth, whose power lies in the mask, and that Sinnia is consumed by it.
timeline.quote: "Saryth isn't the one wearing the mask," Katilda said, picking up her staff.

timeline.summary: The ground splits and the Coiled One begins to rise from a chasm as Saryth screams that it is time and wounds Katilda.
Katilda urges Leinore to destroy Sinnia, but Leinore insists on trying to take the mask off and Katilda agrees to distract Saryth.
timeline.quote: "Don't you dare touch my sister. I'll get the mask off her."

timeline.summary: Katilda fights Saryth with shale and a razor wind of leaves, and Saryth falls into the chasm and is swallowed.
timeline.quote: And in an instant, Saryth was gone—swallowed by the chasm.

relations.note: Saryth fights Katilda in the clearing.
relations.quote: Out of the corner of her eye, she saw Saryth aiming her staff at Katilda now.

relations.note: All of Saryth's power is in the mask.
relations.quote: All of Saryth's power is in that mask.

relations.note: She called it and fed it ensorcelled villagers.
relations.quote: Saryth called him to chase the darkness away and has been feeding him those ensorcelled townsfolk for days now.
